industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: EF-ON Inc.
summary: EF-ON Inc. is an energy service company (ESCO) in Japan that delivers energy-saving solutions by upgrading and optimizing equipment such as heating and hot water systems, compressors, refrigeration, air conditioning and lighting. It is also active in biomass power generation. Established in 1997 and based in Tokyo, it was previously called The First Energy Service Company Limited.
